dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular jagged white perimeters forming several interconnected 'O' and 'C' shapes; sharp gradient transitions from dark exterior to high-contrast white borders with dark interior cores. Prominent rings are visible on the upper left and middle right regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of white pixel clusters along the dorsal ridge; lower density in the mid-flank where large, solid low-intensity dark pigment areas dominate with minimal internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle spanning the upper-left, mid-right, and lower-right lateral quadrants.

other_distinctive_markers: Discrete, high-intensity reflective points localized at the digital extremities of the visible flipper, corresponding to nail/claw structures.
